title: Structured Follow-Up Visit Schedule for Diabetes Management
implementation_guidance: Implement a structured follow-up schedule for nurse care managers to meet individually with patients: initial visit (baseline assessment), 2-week follow-up, 6-week follow-up, 3-month follow-up, 6-month follow-up, 12-month follow-up, and minimum of every 6 months thereafter. Supplement with telephone and email correspondence between visits to maintain engagement and address emerging issues.
expected_outcomes: Improved glycemic control, better medication adherence, earlier identification of barriers to self-management, reduced hospital admissions, increased patient engagement, and improved continuity of care through systematic follow-up.
target_population: Medicaid-enrolled individuals with type 2 diabetes, particularly those with uncontrolled values or multiple comorbidities.
citation: Stuckey HL, Dellasega C, Graber NJ, Mauger DT, Lendel I, Gabbay RA. Diabetes Nurse Case Management and Motivational Interviewing for Change (DYNAMIC): Study Design and Baseline Characteristics in the Chronic Care Model for Type 2 Diabetes. Contemp Clin Trials. 2009;30(4):366-374. doi:10.1016/j.cct.2009.03.002.
